errors.text_span: reaching lowest values between approximately -23.8 in the Infect category and -26.8 in the Cardio category
errors.evidence: The light blue baseline bars are not lowest at Infect and highest at Cardio; in the figure they are around -23.8 for Infect and about -26.7 for Cardio, but the wording 'lowest values' is misleading because more negative values are lower on the axis. The description also inverts the visual meaning of downward extent versus value.

errors.text_span: roughly -22.9, seen in several bars within the Infect category, down to approximately -26.1, seen in the dark brown Pediatrics bar within the Cardio category
errors.evidence: Several of these specific approximate values do not match the bars well: the shortest fine-tuned bars are around -23.0 to -23.1 in Infect, while the darkest Pediatrics bar in Cardio is closer to -26.0 than -26.1. The range is slightly off.

errors.text_span: the remaining six bars in each group correspond to models "Fine-tuned on:" specific specialties, identified by color: light beige (Cardio), peach (Gastro), light orange (Infect), orange (Neuro), brown (Obstetrics), and dark brown (Pediatrics).
errors.evidence: The legend shows the specialty colors in a different order and with different shades than described: after the blue baseline, the series are Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics, but the color names are not accurately matched as 'light beige/peach/light orange/orange/brown/dark brown'. The figure uses a sequence of pale beige through progressively darker orange-brown hues, and the machine description mislabels several of them.
The description does not mention the legend is arranged at the top center, which is a visible structural feature noted in the reference.

errors.text_span: the light blue Mistralv0.2-Base bars exhibit the longest downward extensions
errors.evidence: This phrasing is somewhat misleading because the bars all start from -22 and extend downward; saying 'longest downward extensions' may be read as a general trend, but the actual values vary by category and the visual comparison is better expressed as 'most negative values'.
